notes: Revert the biome map collector from the 2.3.x series and rebaseline on the pre-2.3.0 feature set. Version clipped up from 2.2.18 to 2.4.0 (higher than the last published 2.3.2) so the auto-updater treats this as an update rather than a rollback. Removes the /bridge biomes commands, biome scanner, and biome snapshot functions. The updater now reads the manifest via GitHub's Contents API instead of raw.githubusercontent.com, so a push is detected within one check tick (~90s) instead of waiting out the raw edge cache; default update.check-seconds raised to 90 to stay clear of the API rate limit.
